B1d room aoe2 (order 247, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 12 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (19 threads). No change in placements. The fake DLC and patch notes (t01 T3-001), recruiting and how-to (t02 T3-002 with T3-016), the match talk (t03 T3-031), the retreat, the villager and Wololo proposals (t04 bag under T3-041), repairs against the Finns, t_d and Trump's wall (t05 T3-021 with T3-005 and T3-087), the Irish alliance (t06 bag under T3-150), r/AgePlace, the poll and Discords (t07 T3-153 with T3-090 and T3-066), thanks and stock-taking (t08 T3-009 with T3-072 and T3-073), the clickbait quarrel (t09 T3-037 with T3-075 and T3-016), newcomers welcomed (t10 T3-044 with T3-157), pxls.space declined (t11 T3-054) and the timelapse and wiki (t12 T3-105 with T3-112) hold every concept. Kinds missing from existing bags: c0241, an Irish member saying their policy is to defend, not expand, 'sorry about the rogues', is T3-188 in the t06 bag; c0065 and c0148 (a carrying code), refusing a second logo because it would destroy smaller neighbours, are T3-024 in the t04 bag. For B1e: t11 mostly declines the successor canvas and is glad the event ended (c0197, c0202 to c0206), so T3-054's gate should take the room's answer either way, and the gladness is the registering of the end owed to T3-117's label. c0126 (alt accounts sent to repair) is one peripheral concept in t03. Read plainly: the Good Sunday Agreement with Ireland (c0063); 'It was Trump's wall!' (c0127) and r/The_Donald's attack warned of (c0116, c0175) and thanked among helpers (c0034); Ireland threatening to withdraw support if the room backs the wall (c0076) and the organiser refusing to choose between Ireland and America (c0077); the Finnish flag fought with blue pixels (c0045, c0046, c0052); an attempt to overwrite the Irish flag and the helmet for a Mexican flag (c0196); the US flag said to need erasing (c0136). No new kind; the run is not reset.

B1d room anarcho_capitalism (order 249, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 17 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (49 threads). One change: t10 (trading physical-removal and gulag threats) keeps T3-050 for the taunts traded with communists and r/FullCommunism (c0089, c0124, c0125, c0127, c0170) and takes T3-017 beside it: six of its eleven concepts (c0194 to c0197, c0203, c0204), at hour 94 in the thread 'Understanding the necessity for physical removal', are members arguing among themselves for throwing opponents from helicopters, 'about five stories high' to 'virtually guarantee death' and 'again in batches' if they survive, the sub's usual talk as t16 and t17 hold it (rule 0 line written). The rest hold: the ancap flag (t01 T3-038 with T3-002 and T3-033), Commie Red to Capitalist Gold (t02 T3-068 with T3-006 and T3-086), defending the flag and Bitcoin (t03 T3-005), the snek stepped on by ancaps who did not know (t04 T3-038 with T3-170 and T3-005), homesteading argued (t05 T3-045), small flags when the numbers fail (t06 bag under T3-124), r/The_Donald and Discord recruited (t07 T3-062 with T3-014 and T3-150), spontaneous order and property read from the canvas (t08 T3-179 with T3-037), credit, snitches and a glitch (t09 bag under T3-087), bots (t11 T3-028), the truces with r/FullCommunism, Place Snek and the Void (t12 T3-149 with T3-010 and T3-153), the stock-taking (t13), defeat blamed on collectives and admins (t14 T3-179 with T3-118), pxls.space (t15 T3-054) and the enclaves argument (t16, t17). Read plainly: physical removal and helicopters as the room's language for removing communists (c0023, c0043, c0088) and 'Pinochet Snek' (c0162); calls to have r/The_Donald paint an American flag over the German flag (c0022) and to go after the AnComs (c0060); the Ukrainian flag to become a helicopter (c0030); the hammer and sickle to be removed (c0074, c0118); the feminist and anarcho-queer flags targeted (c0120, c0128); flags read as nationalism (c0032, c0192); the alliance with Poland (c0159, c0161, c0169, c0175); the room's symbol called hate by the anti-hate-symbol campaign (c0147, c0149, c0150). No new kind; the run is not reset.

B1d room brasil (order 256, chosen room) reread: A1 note, 11 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (283 threads). No change. The Argentina-themed CSS takeover and the mock-Spanish play inside it (t01 T3-023 with T3-142), what and where to draw (t02 T3-033 with T3-020 and T3-065), plans, templates and Discord (t03 bag under T3-070), building and upkeep with eight alt accounts (t04 T3-021 with T3-038 and T3-088), raids and defence (t05 bag under T3-006), help bartered with Argentina, Portugal, South Africa, SquareSpiral and others (t06 bag under T3-151), policing who may change the work (t07 bag under T3-087), objections to the flood, bots and stereotypes (t08 bag under T3-075), the told story (t09 bag under T3-009), the record rebuilt and the Great War recolouring (t10 T3-105 with T3-081) and the return to ordinary talk (t11 T3-017 with T3-057 and T3-054) hold every concept. Kinds missing from existing bags: c0382, a member admitting infiltrating the Void's voice chat and being banned, is T3-132 in the t07 bag. For B1e's T3-188 gate: Argentine members telling the room their sub is not the one writing 7-1 (c0058 in t04; c0180, c0213 in the t07 bag) deny the act rather than disown placers acting in their name; the gate should say whether 'it was not us' counts. Read plainly: calls to put Brazil over Argentina's flag, draw a penis on its sun, invade and annex Argentina and Finland (c0015, c0028, c0050, c0185, c0191, c0194, c0200), then peace, Argentine repairers and an alliance proposed (c0230, c0250, c0317, c0470, c0504); the 7-1 written on the flag, blamed on Germans and on Brazilians (c0246, c0484, c0562) and a war process against Germany (c0485); 'Nazi symbols in the German flag' proposed (c0166) and a swastika rejected as very bad taste (c0051); most of the flag's vandals said to be Brazilians (c0210, c0268, c0298); Portugal asked to return the gold (c0256, c0262), the Portuguese Empire and former-colony flags (c0248, c0255, c0463), Lusophony refused (c0423); 'those who sell out to other nations shall not pass' (c0285); Indonesia's and South Africa's delegates (c0204, c0415, c0430); Senna's death as 'our 9/11' (c0454); the prank's political headlines on Lula, Menem, Cristina Kirchner and Temer (c0007, c0068, c0074, c0098, c0099); Dória as 'the Void of Place' (c0541). No new kind; the run is not reset.
